Definitions

Fields the official interfaces do not provide6
  • node.goalwork graph and nav nodes carry no goal; membership exists only per goal (nav --goal), which this map does not query
  • node.scopethe contract or scope id is not exposed per item
  • node.priorityonly work show returns it, one refreshing call per item; not collected in bulk
  • node.milestonethere is no bulk field; it is resolved only for the milestones named in the display configuration, through nav --milestone
  • project.scenariosproject-specific acceptance scenarios are outside the AWR work model and have no data source
  • project.release_funnela presentation concept without a data source
